listing.name: Sol Solar System
listing.summary: Adds a realistic Solar System with accurate planetary data, dynamic content, and support for multiple mod configurations.

description:
new!

Update:

I am uploading a DEV test version of the Sol system written from scratch in 100% Java. Lots of new features with 0 Dependencies!

Content and features are based on other mods installed. Feedback is appreciated.

Be sure to check lunalib options, more settings will be exposed.

Incompatible with the CSS version above!

A meticulously curated Solar System based on Sol.

Uses real data based on NASA and other sources, such as rotation, orbitSpeed, orbitDays, tilt, pitch, size, descriptions etc etc.

Created as best as i could for with Starsector's scales, speeds, and modifiers.

Also serves as an example of what you can do with the fantastic mod of Customizable Star Systems.

Features:

Spoiler[REDACTED] Go Explore! There are about

60

Entities in this system. Lots of things to find. Maybe way out there.

If you need to spawn the system or a new one mid game you can use the console command

SpawnCustomStarSystems css_Sol

Notes:

Spoiler-If you need to spawn a system mid save you can use a console command:Code

spawnCustomStarSystems Sol_Modded or spawnCustomStarSystems Sol_Vanilla

-Be aware that depending on RNG your Sol system could spawn with Meteor Showers, Minefields, Artillery Stations, Special Modded Cryosleepers etc when using other mods that add Procgen entities to systems.

-I have several versions of this system. Vanilla, non-modded, stacked, extreme difficulty, procgen conditions etc. Including the first iteration with realish/vanilla conditions.

Will upload if requested. This is the one i am currently testing. Feel free to edit to your hearts desire. If you need help with this or making your own, just ask.

(can change with setLocation=Any positive whole number n -> n-th closest constellation to Core Worlds, where n is any number greater than 0 (0 will be random)).

-Some moons require a high burn speed in order to catch them.. This isn't an issue for NPC fleets.[close]
